summary: This class explores the reasons and timing for visiting the cemetery during the High Holiday period. It explains why Hakhamim instituted going to the graves of saddiqim before Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur, citing sources such as Hakham Abraham Hamwi and the Zohar. The class also reviews customs recorded in Aleppo and how people visit during Aseret Yeme Teshubah.
subjects: Ribbi Yehuda Ashkenazi in the Ba'er Heteb
Zohar on souls and Rosh Hashanah
questions: What are the reasons for visiting the cemetery before Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur?
What does Hakham Abraham Hamwi explain in his book Bet El about praying at the graves of saddiqim?
What does the Zohar say about souls hearing judgments at the end of Rosh Hashanah?
Should one visit the cemetery on Ereb Rosh Hashanah, Ereb Kippur, or throughout Aseret Yeme Teshubah?
